description: This file defines the French localization (i18n) strings and functions for a chat application, including UI labels, prompts, error messages, and dynamic message formatting functions.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Generates input hints based on the submit key, indicating how to send messages or insert line breaks.

methods.name: Update.Version
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with the current version number.

methods.name: Update.FoundUpdate
methods.description: Returns a string indicating a new firmware version is available.

methods.name: Usage.SubTitle
methods.description: Reports how much of the monthly account balance has been used.

methods.name: Prompt.History
methods.description: Creates a summary string of the chat history for contextual prompts.

methods.name: Prompt.Topic
methods.description: Generates a prompt instructing to create a brief title summarizing the conversation.

methods.name: Prompt.Summarize
methods.description: Creates a prompt to summarize earlier conversations in a concise manner.
